steps.entry: Initial state or pallet cleared after DONE
steps.exit: Pallet arrives in test position (ZS-2008 rising edge) with cell in auto mode, no ST20 fault active, and station idle
steps.name: IDLE

steps.entry: Start conditions met; clamp solenoid XY-2002 energised
steps.exit: Clamp confirmed closed (ZS-2002A made and ZS-2002B clear)
steps.name: CLAMP

steps.entry: Clamp confirmed closed; fill valve XV-2003 opened
steps.exit: Pressure reaches fill complete threshold (14.50 kPa) or 8.0 s timeout occurs
steps.name: FILL

steps.entry: Fill complete reached; fill valve XV-2003 closed
steps.exit: Stabilisation timer expires; baseline pressure recorded
steps.name: STABILISE

steps.exit: 10.0 s test window timer expires; final pressure recorded and decay evaluated
steps.name: TEST

steps.entry: Test window complete (or fault/abort triggered); vent valve XV-2004 opened
steps.exit: Vent timer expires, pack pressure is below 1.00 kPa, and PT-2001 signal is healthy
steps.name: VENT

steps.entry: Vent conditions satisfied; clamp solenoid XY-2002 de-energised
steps.exit: Clamp confirmed open (ZS-2002B made and ZS-2002A clear)
steps.name: UNCLAMP

steps.entry: Clamp confirmed open; PASS or FAIL signal output to line controller
steps.exit: Pallet departs from test position (ZS-2008 clear)
steps.name: DONE
